# Copilot PR approval paths (payku-sdk)
#
# Paste these globs in GitHub:
#   Repository → Settings → Copilot → Code review
#   → Allow Copilot to approve pull requests → On → File paths
#
# Copilot approvals count toward merge requirements only when every
# changed file in the PR matches at least one glob below.
#
# Do not include src/** or .github/workflows/** — those need human review.

*.md
docs/**
.github/FUNDING.yml
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
.github/copilot-instructions.md
.github/copilot-approval-paths.txt
.github/instructions/**
